name: Castellum AB
reason: Swedish commercial-property owner whose FFO/share fell from SEK 9.95 (2021) to 8.41 (2025) with net debt/EBITDA 11.0x, ROIC 4.6% and shares +8.1%/yr from rescue/acquisition issuance; rate-cycle earner with consensus only 4-8%/yr.

name: Autotrader Group PLC
reason: Dominant UK car-listings marketplace with adjusted EPS GBP 0.13 -> 0.34 (10.3% 10y CAGR, 7/10 years >=7%), 62% EBIT margin at a mid-history 55th pctile, 46% avg ROIC, net debt 0.5x EBITDA and shares -1.5%/yr; pricing-power route supports consensus 13-15%/yr (dealer pushback on pricing/AI tools is the deep-dive test).

name: Solvay SA
reason: Post-Syensqo-split commodity chemicals (soda ash, peroxides) with adjusted EPS EUR 5.48 (2023) -> 2.83 (2025), consensus FY1 -19%, revenue -8%/yr and 3.7% avg ROIC; earnings set by commodity chemical pricing.

name: Electrolux AB
reason: Appliance maker with EPS SEK 8.97 (2021) -> losses in 2022-24 -> 1.67 (2025), EBIT margin 1.9% and net debt/EBITDA 3.4x; commoditised, cyclical, no moat.

name: Autoliv Inc.
reason: Airbag/seatbelt oligopoly leader but tied to light-vehicle production: revenue +1.7%/yr over 10y, EPS USD 9.85 is its 10y high with EBIT margin 10.1% at the 91st pctile after a -45% 2020; near-cyclical-peak and auto-cycle driven.

name: Storskogen Group AB
reason: Swedish serial acquirer with acquisitions at 2.46x FCF, EPS SEK 0.86 (2022) -> -0.03 (2024) -> 0.63 (2025) and 4% ROIC; growth bought with leverage, no specialness.

name: Partners Group Holding AG
reason: High-quality private-markets manager (EPS CHF 14.4 -> 48.5, 34% avg ROIC) but performance fees and fundraising tie earnings to capital-markets activity (EPS -29% in 2022, consensus FY1 -17%); same treatment as US alt managers (HLNE, BX).

name: Grifols S.A.
reason: Plasma therapeutics with adjusted EPS EUR 1.07 (2020) -> 0.70 (2025), net debt/EBITDA 4.7x after debt-funded acquisitions (acq/FCF 1.81) and 2024 short-seller/related-party governance questions; leverage and governance fail.

name: Nomad Foods Ltd.
reason: Acquisition-built frozen-food roll-up (Birds Eye, Iglo, Findus) with EPS EUR 1.68 (2022) -> 1.66 (2025), consensus FY1 -13% and LTG ~0%, net debt 3.9x and EBIT margin at the 9th pctile; mature staples with no 7% route.

name: NCC AB
reason: Nordic construction/property developer with EPS SEK 16.74 (2024) -> 1.45 (2025), a loss in 2018 and 2.6% avg EBIT margin; project-cycle earnings with no moat.

name: Rai Way SpA
reason: State-controlled (via RAI) broadcast-tower operator: forecastable contracted revenue and 45% EBIT margin but revenue +2.8%/yr, consensus EPS growth 4-5%/yr and RAI as anchor customer; regulated-style income without a 7% route.

name: Ebro Foods SA
reason: Rice and pasta processor with adjusted EPS EUR 0.88 (2015) -> 1.39 (2025, 4.7% CAGR), revenue +2%/yr and consensus 3-5%/yr; commodity-input staple with no specialness.

name: Kingfisher Plc
reason: DIY retailer (B&Q, Castorama) with adjusted EPS GBP 0.22 (2015) -> 0.24 (2025), ROIC 5.1% and EBIT margin 4.9% at the 27th pctile; housing/consumer-cyclical with no growth record.

name: Karnov Group AB
reason: Legal/tax information publisher with sticky subscriptions but growth bought (acquisitions 2.46x FCF, 3% ROIC), adjusted EPS 3x GAAP (5y gap 302%) and a credible 5-year generative-AI threat to legal research content.

name: Durr AG
reason: Auto paint-shop and woodworking machinery maker with adjusted EPS EUR 2.45 (2015) -> 2.93 (2025, 1.8% CAGR), a 2020 loss and 3.8% EBIT margin; auto-capex cyclical, consensus FY1 -42%.

name: Ottobock SE & Co. KGaA
reason: Prosthetics/orthotics leader with plausible demographic growth (consensus 15-19%/yr) but only a 5-year record since its 2025 IPO, EBIT margin 13.9% at its record high from 2.1% in 2022, net debt 2.6x, reimbursement-driven pricing and a family-controlled KGaA structure.

name: Breedon Group PLC
reason: UK/Irish aggregates and cement whose EPS GBP 0.13 -> 0.32 was acquisition-built (acquisitions 1.18x FCF, shares +4.6%/yr), ROIC 6.9%, margin 7.4% at the 18th pctile and consensus FY1 -12%; construction-cyclical growth via M&A.

name: LDC SA
reason: Well-run family poultry leader (EPS EUR 3.43 -> 9.26, net cash) but feed-grain and avian-flu cycles drive margins, which are at a record 6.2% (100th pctile) with EPS at its 10y high and FCF conversion only 0.59.

name: Arkema SA
reason: Specialty-chemicals mix still with commodity acrylics exposure: adjusted EPS EUR 15.68 (2022) -> 4.32 (2025), EBIT margin 4.6% at the 9th pctile and net debt 2.5x; earnings set by chemical cycle.

name: Antin Infrastructure Partners
reason: Infrastructure fund manager with net cash and high ROIC but earnings tied to fundraising cycles and carried interest (EPS EUR 0.53 in 2020 -> -0.10 in 2022 -> 0.60 in 2025) and a short public record; capital-markets-driven.
